narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative cover: a single image that says 'this air looks breathable and is not' - a human sealed behind an exo-pack faceplate in a glowing forest, the unbreathable world just on the other side of the glass.
subject: A close three-quarter view of a human face behind the clear faceplate of an exo-pack breathing mask, the transparent visor faintly fogged from inside by breath. Reflected across the glass is a dense bioluminescent Pandoran forest - blue-green glowing fronds and drifting spores. The mask's side filter cartridge and flexible hose are partly visible at the jaw.
scene: Night in a luminous Pandoran forest. Glowing spores drift in the heavy air just beyond the glass. The figure's eyes are calm and alert, lit from below by the forest's own light.
camera: Intimate close portrait, shallow depth of field, the faceplate and reflected forest sharp, the background dissolving into glowing haze.
light: Bioluminescent key light rising from below in cyan and teal; a faint warm amber catchlight on the visor edge; cool shadow elsewhere.
palette: Deep void-indigo and teal shadow, cyan and living-teal forest glow on the glass, a scarce warm amber rim along the mask edge.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, strong atmospheric depth, NOT a 3D render or photo.
detail_level: Crisp on the faceplate, breath-fog and reflected fronds; softer glowing haze behind.
composition: Face and faceplate filling the right two-thirds on a third line; reflected forest sweeping across the glass; generous glowing negative space at left.
consistency_notes: This exo-pack design - clear faceplate, side filter cartridge, jaw hose - must match wherever the mask appears in this chapter. Cool Pandora biolum palette throughout.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no oversaturation, no cartoon or anime style
